items.title: Cohomological classification and multiplicities of the Ruelle spectrum of linear pseudo-Anosov maps
items.author: Frédéric Faure; Sébastien Gouëzel; Erwan Lanneau
items.source_version: Publisher native TeX JEP_2019__6__811_0.tex, DOI 10.5802/jep.107; canonical article-ID source replaces stale author-filename link
items.difficulty_reason: Discrete anisotropic resonances do not identify their exact bands or multiplicities in the presence of cone singularities. The authors construct the distribution spaces and differential ladders, identify the surviving classes with first cohomology and control primitives and singularly supported distributions, obtaining the full cohomological resonance formula with the original collision-multiplicity rule.
